snippet.title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist SpeedRunners 2 on Steam & consoles: https://www.speedrunners.com/

SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is an upcoming sequel to the 2016 multiplayer platformer hit, where you must outrun your opponents using items, agility, and perfectly timed moves. The game is coming to PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox X/S on September 3rd, featuring crossplay. It will also be available on day one on Xbox Game Pass for PC & consoles.
